name: stale-generated-file
summary: A field is added to a proto message and the checked-in generated Go for that message is not regenerated, so the two disagree.
why_this_fixture_exists: This should be caught by running the generator and diffing, not by a model reasoning about it. The fixture is here to state a gap: Redline has no regeneration check yet, so today nothing catches it and the eval records a miss. When the check lands this fixture should move from missed to caught with no model involved.

expect.what: schema.proto gained tenant_id and schema.pb.go was not regenerated.
expect.known_gap: No regeneration check ships yet. Deterministic verification belongs in a provider, which knows how to run the generator; see docs/context-envelope.md.
